  11|// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  14|
  15|func TestReconcileFailedParents_AllSubtasksDone(t *testing.T) {
  16|	orch, db, _ := setupReconcileTest(t)
  17|
  18|	parentID := uuid.New()
  19|	parent := model.Task{
  20|		ID:          parentID,
  21|		ProjectID:   orch.projectID,
  22|		Title:       "failed-parent-all-done",
  23|		Description: "parent failed due to merge conflict, but all subtasks eventually completed",
  24|		Status:      model.StatusFailed,
  25|	}
  26|	db.Create(&parent)
  27|
  28|	// Three DONE subtasks — mirrors the real bug scenario (3/3 done, parent stuck failed).
  29|	for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
  30|		sub := model.Task{
  31|			ID:           uuid.New(),
  32|			ProjectID:    orch.projectID,
  33|			ParentTaskID: &parentID,
  34|			Title:        "done-sub",
  35|			Description:  "completed subtask",
  36|			Status:       model.StatusDone,
  37|		}
  38|		db.Create(&sub)
  39|	}
  40|
  41|	n, err := orch.reconcileFailedParents()
  42|	if err != nil {
  43|		t.Fatalf("reconcileFailedParents() error: %v", err)
  44|	}
  45|	if n != 1 {
  46|		t.Errorf("expected 1 parent recovered, got %d", n)
  47|	}
  48|
  49|	// Parent should no longer be failed — it transitions to in_progress first,
  50|	// then checkFeatureCompletion decides the final status.
  51|	var updated model.Task
  52|	db.First(&updated, "id = ?", parentID)
  53|	if updated.Status == model.StatusFailed {
  54|		t.Errorf("parent should have been recovered from failed, still %s", updated.Status)
  55|	}
  56|}
  57|
  58|func TestReconcileFailedParents_SubtasksNotAllDone(t *testing.T) {
  59|	orch, db, _ := setupReconcileTest(t)
  60|
  61|	parentID := uuid.New()
  62|	parent := model.Task{
  63|		ID:          parentID,
  64|		ProjectID:   orch.projectID,
  65|		Title:       "failed-parent-mixed",
  66|		Description: "parent failed, subtasks still in mixed statuses",
  67|		Status:      model.StatusFailed,
  68|	}
  69|	db.Create(&parent)
  70|
  71|	// One DONE, one still IN_PROGRESS — not ready for recovery.
  72|	sub1 := model.Task{
  73|		ID:           uuid.New(),
  74|		ProjectID:    orch.projectID,
  75|		ParentTaskID: &parentID,
  76|		Title:        "done-sub",
  77|		Description:  "completed subtask",
  78|		Status:       model.StatusDone,
  79|	}
  80|	db.Create(&sub1)
  81|
  82|	sub2 := model.Task{
  83|		ID:           uuid.New(),
  84|		ProjectID:    orch.projectID,
  85|		ParentTaskID: &parentID,
  86|		Title:        "wip-sub",
  87|		Description:  "still working",
  88|		Status:       model.StatusInProgress,
  89|	}
  90|	db.Create(&sub2)
  91|
  92|	n, err := orch.reconcileFailedParents()
  93|	if err != nil {
  94|		t.Fatalf("reconcileFailedParents() error: %v", err)
  95|	}
  96|	if n != 0 {
  97|		t.Errorf("expected 0 parents recovered (not all done), got %d", n)
  98|	}
  99|
 100|	// Parent should remain failed.
 101|	var updated model.Task
 102|	db.First(&updated, "id = ?", parentID)
 103|	if updated.Status != model.StatusFailed {
 104|		t.Errorf("expected parent status failed, got %s", updated.Status)
 105|	}

 130|func TestReconcileFailedParents_OnlyFailedParentsTouched(t *testing.T) {
 131|	orch, db, _ := setupReconcileTest(t)
 132|
 133|	// An in_progress parent with all subtasks done should NOT be touched
 134|	// by reconcileFailedParents (that's reconcileCompletedParents' job).

 136|	ipParent := model.Task{
 137|		ID:          ipParentID,

 139|		Title:       "ip-parent",
 140|		Description: "in-progress parent, not failed",
 141|		Status:      model.StatusInProgress,
 142|	}
 143|	db.Create(&ipParent)
 144|
 145|	sub := model.Task{
 146|		ID:           uuid.New(),
 147|		ProjectID:    orch.projectID,
 148|		ParentTaskID: &ipParentID,
 149|		Title:        "done-sub",
 150|		Description:  "done",
 151|		Status:       model.StatusDone,
 152|	}
 153|	db.Create(&sub)
 154|
 155|	n, err := orch.reconcileFailedParents()
 156|	if err != nil {
 157|		t.Fatalf("reconcileFailedParents() error: %v", err)
 158|	}
 159|	if n != 0 {
